title: onboard aether-13b v1.0: perf profiles, metadata, changelog automation
author: Sofia Patel
description:
Motivation: Add Aether-13b v1.0 to the model registry with production-ready metadata, calibrated performance profiles, and automated changelog/release notes generation. This enables serving teams to route to a verified model variant and gives product teams accurate SLO/cost estimates.

What this PR does: - Adds model metadata bundle for aether-13b v1.0 (config, sha, tokenizer spec). - Adds pre-computed performance profiles (latency P50/P95, throughput at common batch sizes) for supported hardware (A100-40GB, A10G, T4). - Adds quantization recommendation matrix and supported quantized artifacts. - Integrates changelog generation hook into the registry pipeline so new model entries automatically produce a draft release note with perf highlights. - Adds unit tests and end-to-end validation script used by CI to sanity-check profiles.

Files of note: - models/aether/metadata.json (model manifest) - perf-profiles/aether-13b/v1.0/profiles.yaml - perf-profiles/aether-13b/v1.0/quantization-recommendations.md - scripts/registry/generate_changelog.py (hook + tests) - tests/model_registry/test_aether_profiles.py

Checklist: - [x] Model manifest includes model_id, version, license, weights_sha, tokenizer, and architecture. - [x] Performance profiles validated against internal perf-lab runs for target seq lengths (64/256/1024). - [x] Quantization matrix validated with representative evals (quality deltas within thresholds). - [x] Changelog automation emits a draft release note and updates the model catalog index. - [x] Docs updated with short onboarding notes and knobs for selecting quantized vs full-precision variants.

Testing & CI: I ran a perf canary on A100 and A10G and recorded latency/throughput numbers in the profile YAML; CI includes a lightweight validation step (tests/model_registry/test_aether_profiles.py) that checks profile schema and that numbers are present for supported hardware. The full perf-suite was run manually in perf-lab (see linked Linear ENG-4021).

Rollout plan: After merge we'll tag model catalog and publish the draft release note for review by product. Serving will expose the new model under the catalog name "aether-13b:v1.0"; routing policies will prefer the non-quantized variant for low-latency tiers and recommend q4_0 or q8_0 for cost-sensitive workloads.

Notes on automation: The changelog generator will include perf highlights as: "Aether-13b v1.0 — P50 latency 45ms (A100), recommended quantization: q4_0 (cost friendly)." The generator is idempotent and safe to run in CI; it writes a draft Markdown file under changelogs/drafts/ that a release manager can edit.

If there are concerns about the perf numbers or quantization recommendations we can revert the changelog automation independently (it is gated by a feature flag in registry config).
